title: The sight they come for
line: Eastleigh Farm's Cow Safari: two cows push over the rail and take bread from a hand.
proof: Sold: fewer than 70 visitors a day, then up to 600

title: A palm stops the thumb
line: Black Country Living Museum: a 1920s grandad by the fire says wait, don't scroll.
proof: Clicks: youth interest in bookings up 15 per cent

title: Light, place, silence
line: Dixie's Lower Antelope Canyon Tours: a guide plays his flute and phones go down.
proof: Kept paying: its owner paid for it 496 days

title: Face and words don't match
line: Fyfield Manor: the owner reads her daughter's slang with a stiff face before the house.
proof: Seen 12.7 million times, 1000 times its usual

title: Name the traveller's habit
line: Away: the maker draws a suitcase for people who live out of their luggage.
proof: Sold: 13 weeks of stock in under three weeks
